pages.text: The Greenhouse retains crops, flowers, or saplings as reusable templates and consumes FE plus Time Fluid to generate their products. Displayed plants are client-only and no real crop blocks are placed or broken.$(br2)$(bold)Quick Start$()$(br2)1. Put up to four plant templates in the left slots. Templates are not consumed; stack size represents parallel plants.$(br)2. Supply FE and Time Fluid, then select a $(thing)1-32x$() speed.$(br)3. Products enter paged output slots and can be sent through auto I/O or directly into adjacent inventories.$(br2)$(bold)Production and Capacity$()

$(bold)Property | Behavior$()$(br)Base speed | 512 growth work per tick at 1x; settles in 20-tick batches by default$(br)Per harvest | 10 FE; recipe Time Fluid divided by 100 and rounded up, minimum 1 mB$(br)Template stacks | Up to half the item's stack limit uses 1x fluid; larger stacks use 2x$(br)Outputs | 16 slots by default; each Capacity Upgrade adds 16, up to 64$(br)Slot limit | 64 by default; 2048/4096/8192 with one/two/three Capacity Upgrades$(br2)Production pauses safely when outputs are blocked. Horizontally adjacent Greenhouses connect visually but keep separate inventories and upgrades.$(br2)$(bold)Plant Compatibility$()

Resolution order is: JDTE data recipe → dedicated Mystical Agriculture integration → Botany Pots → generic plant detection.$(br2)$(li)Built-in recipes cover common vanilla crops, Nether Wart, Cocoa Beans, and saplings.$(li)Mystical Agriculture and Mystical Agradditions use the public Crop Registry and their mature crop drops.$(li)Every loaded Botany Pots crop recipe is enumerated directly, including Spore Blossoms and plants added by mods or datapacks.$(li)Other crops with an $(thing)age$() property and common flowers, saplings, or mushrooms are detected when possible.$(li)Modpacks can add $(thing)jdte:greenhouse$() data recipes with explicit templates, products, and fluid costs.

JEI shows the template, base costs, and preview products. Click the growing-bed progress area to open the category.$(br2)$(bold)Upgrades and Automation$()$(br2)$(li)Supports Capacity, Fluid, Fortune, Overclock, and Creative Upgrades.$(li)Each of up to three Fortune Upgrades adds 10% to average final output.$(li)Overclock or Creative locks production to 64x; Creative removes resource costs.$(li)Auto I/O accepts templates and Time Fluid and exports products. High-volume output is grouped and pushed to adjacent inventories at the end of the tick.$(br2)$(bold)Crafting$()

$(bold)KubeJS: Configured Fluids$()$(br2)Use a $(thing)jdte:greenhouse$() recipe to replace a plant recipe. The Greenhouse, Large Greenhouse, and Greenhouse Matrix share this format.$(br2)$(thing)fluid$() is optional and defaults to $(thing)justdirethings:time_fluid_source$(). $(thing)time_fluid$() remains the amount used per harvest, not a fluid ID. A Greenhouse has one tank and never mixes fluids. After $(thing)/reload$(), old fluid remains extractable, but powers only a recipe that still requires it.

$(bold)KubeJS example$()$(br2)$(thing)ServerEvents.recipes(event => {$(br)  event.remove({ id: 'jdte:greenhouse/wheat' })$(br)  event.custom({ type: 'jdte:greenhouse', seed: { item: 'minecraft:wheat_seeds' }, outputs: [{ id: 'minecraft:wheat', count: 2 }], display_block: 'minecraft:wheat', growth_work: 20, fluid: 'minecraft:water', time_fluid: 100 }).id('jdte:greenhouse/wheat')$(br)})$()
